purpose: City-specific official registry/cadastre and safe anonymous parcel-geometry discovery.

registryAssessment: The municipal government describes SIGMUN as a free city geography platform with cadastral information. Its official REST metadata exposes polygon layer “Predios vinculados al registro público de la propiedad” and safe fields OBJECTID and clave_guio. The bounded exact-point query was not successfully retrieved, so no sample parcel was verified.
